review_attestation.method: Independent manual derivation of the exact four-point conjunction, its zero-ring exception, and its relation to global affine agreement with multiplication.
review_attestation.scope: For every affine coefficient triple in a nontrivial commutative ring with identity, at least one of the four designated agreement equations fails. For any allowed ring and fixed triple, the conjunction and global agreement are each equivalent to 0=1.
qualifications: The finite statement supplies a fixed finite set containing a disagreement point. Within this exact affine family, it is equivalent to global nonagreement rather than a strictly stronger ring condition.
In the zero ring, the conjunction and global agreement both hold; nontriviality is necessary.
Agreement at the four points does not certify global agreement for arbitrary functions outside the affine family.
